We observe that the results of Theorems 1.3 and 1.4 are inﬂuenced by β, even though
the weights dβ ∈A2 for all β ∈(−1, 1). This demonstrates that the regularity of the
solution to (1.2) is not solely dependent on the Muckenhoupt class, but rather on the
explicit structure of the weight. Lastly, we note that our results extend to more general
weights w that behave similarly near the boundary (see Remark 3.1).
The paper is organized as follows: in Section 2 we provide some additional properties of
the weight dβ and recall other known results; in Section 3 we give the proof of the main
estimates of Theorem 1.2, and in Section 4 we prove Theorems 1.3 and 1.4.
